_comment: Layout scope and device realization for layout/lna_core (issue #63). Read by generate.py (what to draw) and layout/lvs_reference.py (what the LVS reference contains). 'in_scope' maps each design/netlist/lna.spice instance this bring-up draws to the PDK PyCell that realizes it; 'out_of_scope' lists every other instance with the reason it is not drawn. 'modeled_in_device' (#347) lists netlist elements that are bench-model loss of a drawn device and have no physical realization of their own. lvs_reference.py fails if in_scope, modeled_in_device and out_of_scope do not partition the netlist exactly, so a netlist change cannot silently fall out of both.

nx.meaning: npn13G2 emitter count (Nx) of the cascode pair. Issue #58's emitter-array decision lands as a change to this one value (generate.py --nx), not a redraw. Q3 stays Nx=1: DR-0003's island is a density match to Q1 at the netlist's own Nx=8 ratio, so changing nx without re-sizing the island is a design change this script does not make on its own.

XQ3.role: DR-0003 bias island: diode-connected density-match reference

R3b.role: DR-0003 bias island: bref -> b1 coupling resistor
R3b.realization_note: Schematic value is an ideal 330 ohm. Realized as rppd w=1u l=1.005u; the PyCell's own model-formula readout for that geometry is r=329.74 ohm (PyCell TEXT label, which includes the PDK's end resistance Rzspec). This choice is a layout-time realization, not a re-sizing of the design.

Rbleed.role: DC bleed of the output-match node: xout -> vss (issue #258; keeps check-floating-nodes green now that xout only feeds out-of-scope caps)
Rbleed.realization_note: Schematic value is an ideal 100 kOhm. Realized as rppd w=1u l=386.650u (length on the 0.005 um manufacturing grid, so the PyCell's end-pad Cont vertices pass the klt 0.9.2 deck's cont.ongrid.1 rule; the 2 nm shortening is ~0.5 ohm, 0.0005 % of the value); the PyCell's own model-formula readout for that geometry is r=100.000 kOhm (R = l/(w+lwd)*Rspec + 2*Rzspec/w, with Rspec=260 ohm/sq, lwd=6 nm, Rzspec=35 ohm*um). xout is outside this cell's drawn scope (it is Cout's match-node side), so the resistor's lower pad carries the cell's xout port label; the upper pad lands on the vss rail, extended west over it.

Cbref.role: DR-0003 bias island: RF ground of the bref node
Cbref.realization_note: Schematic value is an ideal 100 pF. Realized as 16 parallel cmim units of 64.5 x 64.5 um: 16 x (4160.25 um^2 x 1.5 fF/um^2 + 258 um x 0.04 fF/um) = 100.0 pF at the cap_typ coefficients. cmim's own Cmax is 8 pF per instance, hence the bank.

XMis.role: DR-0003 island feed: 12.8:1 mirror bank copying I_ref into bref
XMis.realization_note: Schematic is ng=1 w=512u; drawn as 32 fingers of 16u (same total W, same L). The fingers' gates are tied by a GatPoly bus generate.py draws; the netlist's single device corresponds to 32 parallel layout devices.

Le.role: emitter-degeneration inductor (e1 -> vss), Rle modeled in device
Le.realization_note: Schematic 1 nH. A 1-turn PCell reaches only 0.03-0.37 nH, so Le is drawn with the 4-turn extracted cell's w/s (8.22/3.74 um, EM point p11) and d solved for 1.000 nH: d=30.13 um vs the extracted d=141.975 um. NOT EM-verified: interpolated d, outside every extracted geometry.

Lc.role: load inductor (vdd -> outn), Rlc modeled in device
Lc.realization_note: Schematic 5 nH. 5-turn w/s of the extracted EM point p13 (6.1/3.29 um); d=109.15 um vs the extracted d=110.11 um (1 um away), 5.000 nH vs 5.047 nH at the extracted d. Closest to an EM-verified geometry of the three.

Lb.role: input series inductor (xin -> rfin), Rlb modeled in device
Lb.realization_note: Schematic 4.56374 nH. 4-turn w/s of EM point p11; d=151.95 um solved for 4.564 nH vs the extracted d=141.975 um (4.231 nH there): a 10 um extrapolation. NOT EM-verified.

Cin.realization_note: Schematic 100 pF; realized as 16 parallel 64.5 x 64.5 um cmim units (same unit and arithmetic as Cbref): 100.01 pF at the cap_typ coefficients. Top plates = b1, bottom plates (one merged Metal5 sheet) = xin.

Cout.realization_note: Schematic 100 pF; 16 parallel 64.5 x 64.5 um cmim units: 100.01 pF at the cap_typ coefficients. Top plates = outn, bottom sheet = xout.

Cpin.realization_note: Schematic 0.625995 pF; one cmim 20.375 x 20.375 um: 1.5 fF/um^2 x 415.14 um^2 + 0.04 fF/um x 81.5 um = 625.97 fF. Top = xin, bottom = vss.

Cpout.realization_note: Schematic 0.504268 pF; one cmim 18.28 x 18.28 um: 504.16 fF at the cap_typ coefficients. Top = xout, bottom = vss.

Csout.realization_note: Schematic 0.346489 pF; one cmim 15.145 x 15.145 um: 346.48 fF at the cap_typ coefficients. Top = xout, bottom = rfout.

Rseed.role: DR-0003 reference core Stage-1 skeleton startup seed (vdd -> nc_a)
Rseed.realization_note: Schematic value is an ideal 10 MOhm. rppd would need ~19 mm of poly at 260 ohm/sq, so it is drawn as an rhigh (1360 ohm/sq class) meander: w=0.5u, 34 segments of l=98.82u (bends b=33). The PyCell's own readout for that geometry is r=9.99996 MOhm. The meander is one resistor between the two end pads (vdd, nc_a). klt's extraction of the drawn meander reports r=10.049 MOhm (+0.49 %: corner/bend contributions the PyCell readout omits) with L=3398.82 um (total path), so the LVS reference card carries the per-segment L and the parameter is not compared (device.geometry_not_compared).

Rle.reason: Rle is the Q = 10 loss of Le (parallel across it), a bench-model element with no physical device (sim/models/SOURCE.md: the drawn inductor's own series R / substrate loss is the physical counterpart). Drawing a resistor would change the design's Q, a design change not layout.
